NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Makes Google Photos dark surfaces true black.

patches.name: Ad-free feed (remove promoted Pins)
patches.description: Removes promoted/sponsored Pins from every feed, search result, and board list during deserialization, so they never render. Organic pinning, boards and saving are unaffected.

patches.name: Allow re-signed/sideloaded installs
patches.description: Neutralizes Mereframe's install-integrity checks so patched (re-signed) builds start normally instead of showing the installation-refused screen. Required for any other patch here to be usable.

patches.name: Allow screenshots & screen recording
patches.description: Removes FLAG_SECURE and secure-surface flags from MUBI's players, so screenshots, screen recording and screen mirroring work. DRM-protected video may still render black on some devices.

patches.name: Allow screenshots & screen recording
patches.description:
Attempts to remove recognizable FLAG_SECURE and secure SurfaceView settings
so screenshots and screen recordings can work. Some screens or protection
methods may still block capture, including payment or banking screens.

Applies to any app. Do not combine with "Block screenshots & screen recording".

patches.name: Anti-delete messages
patches.description: Prevents messages deleted by other users from being removed locally.

patches.name: Anti-disappearing media
patches.description: Keeps view-once photos, videos and voice messages viewable indefinitely.

patches.name: Anti-screenshot notification
patches.description: Blocks screenshot notifications from being sent to the other user.

patches.name: Block AutoMod comments
patches.description: Hides all comments from u/AutoModerator, including stickied bot comments. AutoModerator posts are kept. Client-side only; off by default.

patches.name: Block Firefox telemetry
patches.description: IronFox-style hardening: never initializes Glean telemetry, Nimbus experiments, Sentry crash reporting, or Adjust attribution at startup; kills Mozilla-side server traffic during browsing (Firefox Suggest/Merino, sponsored shortcuts/Contile, Pocket feed + sponsored stories, search suggestion streaming incl. private tabs, studies previews); and makes the telemetry toggles in Settings read OFF. Browsing, Sync and add-ons keep working; local-only suggestions untouched.

patches.name: Block Motion Sensors
patches.description: Attempts to disable Chromium's Android sensor provider; may also block ambient sensors. Requires device validation.

patches.name: Block Popups & Ratings
patches.description: Disables the identified rating and Brave Ads signup eligibility checks; other dialogs can still appear.

patches.name: Block Sentry telemetry
patches.description: Disables Sentry crash/error/performance telemetry entirely by neutralizing the configurator that writes the DSN - with no DSN set, Sentry self-disables. Fixes nothing to break: the configurator's return is void and unused. Verified against 1.261023.20.

patches.name: Block Telemetry
patches.description: Blocks usage analytics, crash uploads and experiment downloads.

options.title: Block offers server
options.description: Also blocks the shopping offers server. Turn off to keep it.

patches.name: Block analytics & data collection
patches.description: Neutralizes Firebase Analytics, AppsFlyer, CleverTap event fan-out and the in-house crash-report enqueue of District by Zomato.

patches.name: Block analytics & tracking
patches.description: No-ops Braze, Firebase Analytics, AppsFlyer, Adjust, Facebook App Events and Segment logging in MUBI. Push notifications and account features keep working.

patches.name: Block analytics & tracking SDKs
patches.description:
Disables common analytics/tracking SDKs (Firebase Analytics, AppsFlyer, Adjust,
Facebook AppEvents, Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel and similar) by removing their
event-reporting calls.

Heuristic: obfuscated or reflection-based reporting is not covered. Applies to
any app.

patches.name: Block analytics and data collection
patches.description: No-ops Firebase screen/event tracking and AppsFlyer attribution + event logging (concrete SDK entry points, verified in 14.41.0). Push notifications keep working; Pinterest features are untouched.

patches.name: Block analytics and data collection
patches.description: Stops Strava's Braze telemetry bootstrap (session + engagement tracking, endpoint sdk.iad-07.braze.com) before it is configured. Firebase Analytics collection and Facebook auto event logging are already off in Strava's own manifest; this removes the one tracker pipe that is actually live. Push, GPS, and recording keep working.

patches.name: Block cleartext (HTTP) traffic
patches.description:
Sets android:usesCleartextTraffic="false" so the app cannot send plaintext
HTTP requests. Breaks apps that still use legacy HTTP endpoints.

Applies to any app.

patches.name: Block location tracking
patches.description: Stops District by Zomato from acquiring GPS fixes (continuous updates + one-shot fetch). Manual city selection still works.

patches.name: Block screenshots & screen recording
patches.description:
Attempts to add FLAG_SECURE to activity windows and secure SurfaceViews.
This can make screenshots and screen recordings show a black surface.
Only recognizable code with available registers can be changed, so this
is not a guarantee that all screens or capture methods are protected.

Applies to any app. Do not combine with "Allow screenshots & screen recording".

patches.name: Block upgrade & sale deep links
patches.description: Makes MUBI's upgrade screen non-exported and disables the upgrade-yearly / blackfriday / flash-sale deep links. Playback and entitlements are unchanged.

patches.name: Block user-added certificate authorities
patches.description:
Removes user-added certificate authorities from the app's network security
config (if it declares one), so the app does not trust certificates installed
on the device.

Applies to any app. No effect if the app has no network security config.

patches.name: Brave Origin
patches.description: Unlocks Brave Origin feature switches across Rewards, News, Wallet, and VPN.

patches.name: Bypass channel restrictions
patches.description: Allows opening, viewing, saving and forwarding content from restricted, sensitive, and copyright-restricted channels.

patches.name: Bypass content restrictions
patches.description: Allows saving and forwarding content from restricted channels, chats, and users.

patches.name: Bypass forced update
patches.description: Neutralizes Play Core's update-availability checks so MUBI does not block startup on a newer version. Running an outdated build may break playback.

patches.name: Bypass integrity check
patches.description: Spoofs certificate fingerprint and SafetyNet results so login works on patched APK.

patches.name: Bypass native integrity checks
patches.description: libunnamed_raw.so JNI-throws 'app integrity check failed' on re-signed builds, killing camera session start (preview) - observed via diagnostic crash log. This patch catches the throw at the session-opening wrapper and substitutes a valid session result. Required together with 'Allow re-signed/sideloaded installs'.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Installs Google Photos beside the system Photos app by changing package, permissions, providers, and app name.

options.title: Package name
options.description: Package name for the cloned Google Photos app.

options.title: App name
options.description: Launcher name for the cloned Google Photos app.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Installs MUBI beside the official app by changing the package, permission names, provider authorities and launcher label. Play Billing, Cast and Google sign-in may not work on the clone.

options.title: Package name
options.description: Package name for the cloned MUBI app.

options.title: App name
options.description: Launcher name for the cloned MUBI app.

patches.name: Change package name (clone app)
patches.description:
Installs a clone of any app beside the original by changing the package,
permission names, provider authorities and launcher label.

The clone is re-signed: payments, SDK logins, Google sign-in and anti-fraud
checks bound to the original signature may not work on the clone.

options.title: Package name
options.description: Package name for the cloned app. Leave empty for the default (app.morphe.<app name>).

options.title: App name
options.description: Launcher name for the cloned app. Leave empty to append "(Proteus)" to the current label.

patches.name: Clean New Tab
patches.description: Removes sponsored wallpapers, news feed and promo cards.

options.title: Hide shortcut tiles
options.description: Removes most-visited tiles for a blank start page.

patches.name: Close Tab In Group Order
patches.description: Selects the previous tab in the tab group when closing a tab.

patches.name: Content filters
patches.description: Adds patch-time keyword, community, author and flair filters for feed posts (optionally comments), and locally bypasses Reddit's NSFW/spoiler/quarantine gates and over-18 account flags. Server-side filtering still applies. Off by default.

options.title: Keywords to hide
options.description: Comma-separated words or phrases hidden from titles, bodies and flairs (case-insensitive, literal match).

options.title: Communities to hide
options.description: Comma-separated subreddit names, with or without the r/ prefix.

options.title: Authors to hide
options.description: Comma-separated user names, with or without the u/ prefix.

options.title: Flairs to hide
options.description: Comma-separated flair texts. Use community::flair to scope a rule to one community.

options.title: Match mode
options.description: Hide a row when any rule matches, or only when every configured category matches.

options.title: Bypass built-in content gates
options.description: Force over-18 account flags and clear local NSFW/spoiler/quarantine blur gates. Server-side filters still apply.

options.title: Also filter comments
options.description: Apply the keyword/author filters to comment rows in threads as well as feed posts.

patches.name: Custom Brave theme
patches.description: Applies custom colors to Brave dark mode chrome, defaulting to pure OLED black for battery saving on OLED screens.

options.title: Background color
options.description: Opaque hexadecimal color for primary backgrounds and base window chrome. Defaults to pure OLED black (#000000).

options.title: Surfaces use background color
options.description: When enabled, cards, sheets, and dialogs share the primary background color. When disabled, elevated surfaces use the dedicated surface color below.

options.title: Surface / container color
options.description: Opaque hexadecimal color for elevated surfaces such as cards, sheets, and dialogs. Defaults to OLED black (#000000); use #1e2029 for visible depth between tiers.

options.title: Text ink color
options.description: Opaque hexadecimal color applied to primary text labels. Defaults to Brave light slate ink (#f0f2ff).

options.title: Accent highlight color
options.description: Opaque hexadecimal color for interactive highlights, active switches, and links. Defaults to Brave purple-blue accent (#737ade).

options.title: Disable Material You dynamic colors
options.description: Prevents Android 12+ wallpaper palette extraction from replacing dark surfaces. When disabled, dynamic system colors take precedence.

options.title: Window background color
options.description: Opaque hexadecimal color for root window backgrounds in two-tier surface mode. Defaults to pure black (#000000).

options.title: Preference card color
options.description: Opaque hexadecimal color for preference item cards in Settings. Defaults to OLED black (#000000); use #1e2029 for visible depth between tiers.

options.title: Style preference rows as cards
options.description: Wraps settings and preference rows in rounded card shapes when two-tier surfaces are enabled.

options.title: Modulate text tiers by luminance
options.description: When enabled, scales text brightness across primary, secondary, and disabled tiers using luminance ratios. When disabled, applies the text ink color uniformly.

options.title: Patch Material You system color roles
options.description: Rewrites Android system neutral and surface container color roles in values-v31+ directories to theme colors.

options.title: Patch color state list lStar selectors
options.description: Rewrites tonal luminance selectors in color resources to match custom background and container surfaces.

options.title: Patch vector drawable surface fills
options.description: Rewrites hardcoded background and container fill colors inside vector drawables to match theme colors.

patches.name: Custom branding
patches.description: Adds an option to replace the Google Photos launcher icon.

options.title: Custom icon
options.description:
Folder containing a Morphe adaptive icon set.

Supported density folders:
- mipmap-mdpi
- mipmap-hdpi
- mipmap-xhdpi
- mipmap-xxhdpi
- mipmap-xxxhdpi

Each included density folder must contain:
- morphe_adaptive_background_custom.png
- morphe_adaptive_foreground_custom.png

Optional themed icon:
- drawable/morphe_adaptive_monochrome_custom.xml

patches.name: Dark mode
patches.description: Force dark mode for Amazon Shopping.

options.title: Dark mode
options.description: Off / Follow system / Always on.

patches.name: Diagnostic crash log
patches.description: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - writes the full stack trace to Downloads/mereframe-crash-*.txt when the app crashes, for remote diagnosis. Off by default; enable when asked to produce a crash log. Chain-forwards to the original crash handler.

patches.name: Disable Click Tracking
patches.description: Forces the outbound click-tracking account preference off at the Account deserialization choke point (local; server-side click analytics may still be recorded). Enabled by default.

patches.name: Disable PairIP license check
patches.description:
Disables PairIP license verification: integrity/VM checks, the licensing
client and repeated background checks.

Applies to any app. No effect if the app does not use PairIP.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Blocks Firebase analytics and event tracking in Telegram Plus. FirebaseApp.initializeApp() is preserved so push notifications keep working.

patches.name: Disable app backup (allowBackup=false)
patches.description:
Sets android:allowBackup="false" so the app's private data is excluded from
ADB backups, cloud backups and device-to-device transfers.

Applies to any app. You lose automatic backup/restore of this app's data.

patches.name: Disable auto-update
patches.description: Disables automatic app update checks, the blocking update screen, and the proxy sponsor channel insertion. On Telegram Plus also disables the Plus-specific updater and update settings flag.

patches.name: Disable autoplay previews
patches.description: Stops MUBI's home/browse screens from autoplaying muted trailers and previews. Opening a title still plays normally.

patches.name: Disable channel switching
patches.description: Disables the pull-down gesture that switches to the next unread channel.

patches.name: Disable search suggestions tracking
patches.description: Prevents search keypress and focus events from being sent with suggestion requests.

patches.name: Disable video autoplay
patches.description: Prevents videos from autoplaying in Amazon's in-app WebView pages.

patches.name: Download speed boost
patches.description: Increases download chunk size to 1 MB and max concurrent requests to 12.

patches.name: Employee Debug Flags
patches.description: Spoofs is_employee locally at the Account JSON adapter, exposing Reddit's internal employee/debug UI menus (mostly non-functional without the employee backend, and a few may misbehave — enable for exploration only). Off by default.

patches.name: Empty telephony identifiers (IMEI, phone number, SIM)
patches.description:
Makes TelephonyManager device-identifier getters (IMEI, device ID, phone
number, subscriber ID, SIM serial, software version) return an empty string
to the app.

Applies to any app. Features that need the real IMEI/number may degrade.

patches.name: Enable DCIM folders backup control
patches.description: Allows controlling Camera and other DCIM folder backup individually.

patches.name: Enable media downloads
patches.description: Enables the pin-level image download eligibility flag. Use the separate experimental video download patch for supported video Pins.

patches.name: Enable picture-in-picture
patches.description: Adds PiP support to MUBI's phone/tablet player: playback continues in a floating window when you press Home.

patches.name: Enable video download
patches.description: Experimental: enables the download row on video Pins and saves an available MP4. Streaming-only or unavailable videos are reported instead of saved as images.

patches.name: Fix Amazon manifest conflicts
patches.description: Updates shared Amazon permissions so other Amazon apps can coexist.

patches.name: Fix DCIM folder classification
patches.description: Prevents non-Camera DCIM folders from being grouped as Camera.

patches.name: Fix Firebase after re-signing
patches.description:
Fixes Firebase services (push notifications, Remote Config, Firebase Auth) that break after Morphe re-signs the app with a different certificate.

Apply with Original app certificate patch — no other config needed.

patches.name: Force TV (leanback) UI
patches.description: Makes MUBI believe the device is a television, so Android TV boxes that misreport their form factor open the leanback UI. Do not enable on phones.

patches.name: Force highest video quality
patches.description: Reports a 1 Gbps connection to ExoPlayer/Media3 so MUBI picks the highest available rendition instead of downshifting. May increase data use and buffering on slow connections; server-side caps still apply.

patches.name: Force not debuggable
patches.description:
Sets android:debuggable="false" in the manifest so the patched app cannot be
inspected or modified over ADB/USB debugging.

Applies to any app. Safe for release builds.

patches.name: Force password login (OTP bypass)
patches.description: Always shows the password login field instead of the OTP code flow. OFF by default: breaks log-in AND sign-up for OTP-only accounts. Enable only if your Strava account has an actual password.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Adds MicroG/GmsCore support metadata for Google Photos.

patches.name: GmsCore support (MicroG)
patches.description:
Routes Google Play Services calls through MicroG instead of real GPS.

Works for: Google apps (YouTube, Maps, News, Photos) and third-party apps using classic Google Sign-In (Android 13 and below).

Does not work for: Android 14+ Credential Manager sign-in (most modern third-party apps), Play Integrity / SafetyNet checks, or apps with custom auth.

Requires MicroG RE installed. Apply with Original app certificate patch.

options.title: MicroG package name
options.description: Which MicroG / GmsCore app is installed on your device. Check your device's app list for "MicroG" or "GmsCore" if unsure — most users should leave this as the default.

options.title: Main activity class (optional)
options.description: The app's main Activity class name ending with a semicolon, e.g. /MainActivity; Used to inject the MicroG check at startup. Leave blank for auto-detection.

options.title: Custom package name (optional)
options.description: Rename the app to this package name. Leave blank to keep the original. Must be a valid package name (e.g. com.example.myapp).

patches.name: Hide Rufus tab
patches.description: Removes the Rufus AI assistant tab from Amazon's bottom navigation bar.

patches.name: Hide developer options & USB debugging
patches.description:
Makes the app think Developer Options, USB (ADB) debugging and wireless
debugging are disabled, by forcing the settings reads apps use for these
checks to return "off" / "0".

Applies to any app. Only affects what the app itself sees.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Hides your typing indicator from other users in all chats. On Telegram Plus also silences the controller-level sendTyping dispatcher.

patches.name: Improve startup performance
patches.description: Skips two launch-time routines whose only job is metrics/experiments upkeep: the 4k-line startup-metrics coroutine (pure telemetry writes, ~64 metric writes per launch) and the forced Nimbus experiment fetch right after first render. Less launch I/O = faster, smoother open/close. Browser features unchanged.

patches.name: Inure — Unlock Full Version (GitHub)
patches.description: Bypasses the 15-day trial gate and unlocks all premium features in Inure App Manager (GitHub).

patches.name: Lock down exported components
patches.description:
Sets android:exported="false" on activities, services and receivers that have no
intent filter, so other apps cannot start them directly. Deep links, share-in
targets and the launcher activity (all of them have intent filters) are never
touched.

Applies to any app. May break apps that rely on explicitly exported entry points.

patches.name: Offline-only voice typing & telemetry reduction
patches.description:
On Gboard 18.5.4.993608717 arm64, routes core voice typing only through the on-device
recognizers and returns no recognizer when a local provider/model is unavailable (no
online fallback). Disables Agentic Dictation's server/batch retry path, reduces selected
metrics/telemetry and disables app backup. INTERNET and unrelated network features are
retained; this is best-effort telemetry reduction, not a guarantee of zero Google traffic.

Requires the appropriate offline speech model/provider to be installed. Without one,
voice typing is unavailable by design. Agentic Dictation is disabled.

patches.name: Open links in browser
patches.description: Opens non-Amazon URLs in the default browser instead of the in-app WebView.

patches.name: Packaging toolkit (signature, install source, MicroG)
patches.description: Applies the shared signature, install-source and GmsCore/MicroG patches to MUBI in one step. Does not bypass Play Integrity or fix Play Billing.

patches.name: Prefer external browser over Custom Tabs
patches.description: Removes MUBI's Custom Tabs service query so browser links can fall back to the normal external browser. No effect if MUBI launches Custom Tabs directly.

patches.name: Prefer external browser over Custom Tabs
patches.description:
Opens links in the default external browser instead of an in-app Custom Tab,
by rewriting CustomTabsIntent.launchUrl call sites into ACTION_VIEW intents.

Applies to any app. Some apps rely on the Custom Tab session (shared cookies,
return results) and may misbehave.

patches.name: Preserve last active tab
patches.description: Disables the identified new-tab opening-screen override after inactivity. Does not prevent tab unloading under memory pressure.

patches.name: Price history charts
patches.description: Injects Keepa and CamelCamelCamel price history charts on Amazon product pages.

options.title: Chart period
options.description: Default time range for the price history charts.

options.title: Show period toggle
options.description: Add period buttons under each chart to switch views.

options.title: Toggle periods
options.description: Which periods appear in the toggle buttons.

options.title: Keepa price lines
options.description: Which price series the Keepa chart shows.

options.title: CamelCamelCamel chart
options.description: Which price lines the CCC chart shows.

options.title: Hide zero-price gaps
options.description: Omit flat zero-price segments on the CCC chart.

options.title: Chart size
options.description: Width of the CCC chart image (Keepa renders at a fixed size).

options.title: Start collapsed
options.description: Render the charts inside a collapsed section; tap to expand.

patches.name: Privacy: block trackers & analytics
patches.description: Suppresses ChatGPT product analytics, Statsig events/exposures, Segment event dispatch and Bitdrift crash/session-replay startup; disables Datadog RUM and removes ad-ID/install-referrer access. Chat, login, files and push notifications are preserved. Core service requests and server-side logging cannot be disabled by an APK patch.

patches.name: Privacy: no location, contacts or phone data
patches.description: Removes ChatGPT's location, contacts, phone-state and SMS-send permissions. Location-based answers, contact lookup, phone-state access and direct SMS sending are disabled. Call/voice-assistant framework permissions, chat, files and push notifications are preserved.

patches.name: Privacy: no mic or camera
patches.description: Removes RECORD_AUDIO, CAMERA, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE plus all camera/microphone uses-feature declarations from the manifest. Voice Mode and camera capture become impossible (not merely denied - the grant dialog itself is gone). File storage, notifications and everything else are untouched.

patches.name: Provide Original app certificate
patches.description: Automatically reads the signing certificate from the APK you are patching — no original app installed or file provided needed. Only fill the options below if you are patching an APK that was already re-signed (e.g. a previously patched build): in that case point to the original APK file, or enter the certificate manually.

options.title: Path to original APK (if uninstalled)
options.description: Full path to the original APK or .apks bundle. Example: /sdcard/Download/Waze.apks

options.title: Certificate SHA-1 (manual)
options.description: 40-char hex. Found on APKMirror under app signature info.

options.title: Certificate SHA-256 (manual)
options.description: 64-char hex. Optional companion to SHA-1.

options.title: Certificate Base64 DER (manual)
options.description: Needed only for Signature spoof patch. Get it with: apksigner verify --print-certs original.apk

patches.name: Remove Extra Languages
patches.description: Replaces larger unselected Chromium locale PAKs with the English fallback; gender variants and Android resources are not removed.

options.title: Languages to keep
options.description: Comma-separated language codes such as en-US, fr, hi. English is always kept; choosing a language keeps all its regions.

patches.name: Remove Unused AI & VPN
patches.description: Deletes unused AR and XR files to shrink the app.

options.title: Remove VPN library
options.description: Also deletes the WireGuard library. Brave VPN stops working.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Hides sponsored and ad content in Amazon Shopping via CSS injection.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Hides promoted posts in feeds and banner ads in comment threads.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored messages and video ads from all chats and channels. On Telegram Plus also blocks native banner and inline ads.

patches.name: Remove dangerous permissions
patches.description:
Removes selected permission declarations from an app's manifest. The patch
is off by default. When enabled, all category switches start ON, including
camera, storage, SMS and notifications. Turn off categories the app needs.

Permissions to keep always wins. Extra permissions are added to the selected
categories. A non-empty advanced list replaces the category selections,
except that AdServices remains controlled by its own switch.

Removing permissions can break features or prevent an app from starting.
This does not block every way an app may collect data.

options.title: Package visibility
options.description: Remove QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES (app can no longer enumerate every installed app).

options.title: Phone state & numbers
options.description: Remove phone state, phone numbers and calling permissions. Calls or sign-in may stop working.

options.title: Accounts
options.description: Remove GET_ACCOUNTS. Account discovery or sign-in may stop working.

options.title: Location
options.description: Remove fine, coarse and background location. Maps or location features may stop working.

options.title: Contacts
options.description: Remove read/write contacts. Contact sync and sharing may stop working.

options.title: Microphone
options.description: Remove RECORD_AUDIO. Voice messages, calls and recording may stop working.

options.title: Camera
options.description: Remove CAMERA. Disable this if the app needs to take photos or scan QR codes.

options.title: Storage & media
options.description: Remove storage and media permissions. File access and media features may stop working.

options.title: SMS
options.description: Remove SMS permissions. Messaging or automatic verification may stop working.

options.title: Calendar
options.description: Remove read/write calendar permissions. Calendar integration may stop working.

options.title: Sensors & activity
options.description: Remove BODY_SENSORS and ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION. Fitness features may stop working.

options.title: Nearby devices
options.description: Remove Bluetooth and nearby Wi-Fi permissions. Device pairing may stop working.

options.title: Screen-capture detection
options.description: Remove DETECT_SCREEN_CAPTURE (Android 14+ screenshot detection).

options.title: Advertising ID
options.description: Remove com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID.

options.title: AdServices permissions
options.description: Remove every android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_* entry.

options.title: Notifications
options.description: Remove POST_NOTIFICATIONS. Disable this if you still want app notifications.

options.title: Permissions to keep
options.description: Always keep these permissions, even if a category, extra list or AdServices would remove them. Use commas, semicolons or new lines; e.g. CAMERA, POST_NOTIFICATIONS.

options.title: Extra permissions to remove
options.description: Add permissions to remove. Use commas, semicolons or new lines; e.g. CAMERA or com.example.permission.CUSTOM. The keep list takes priority.

options.title: Advanced: exact removal list
options.description: Legacy override: when non-empty, replaces the category selections with this list. AdServices is still controlled by its switch; extra and keep lists still apply. Leave blank to use categories.

patches.name: Remove promo cards & upsell banners
patches.description: Disables Braze Content Cards, the Braze feed and card refreshes in MUBI. Push notifications and the app's own screens are untouched.

patches.name: Remove tracking & analytics
patches.description: Kills Facebook auto-init and OneSignal, and opts Firebase Crashlytics/Performance/Analytics out of collection at boot, in Everything Widgets. Widget functionality is unaffected; OneSignal push notifications stop.

patches.name: Show deleted comments
patches.description: Shows the original text of comments deleted or removed on Reddit, restored at render time from the free Arctic Shift archive (no API key; falls back to PullPush). Only the ids of deleted comments in the threads you open are sent, and restored text is prefixed with [archived]. Coverage depends on the archive; needs network. Off by default.

patches.name: Skip TV confirmation dialog
patches.description: Closes MUBI's Android TV confirmation screen before it draws. Only useful on TV devices; a flow waiting on a dialog result may stall.

patches.name: Skip Welcome Screens
patches.description: Reports the first-run flow complete; may skip essential consent, search or setup screens.

patches.name: Skip pre-roll promos
patches.description: Disables MUBI's app-side pre-roll gate when it is a boolean check. Pre-roll injected by the server or embedded in the stream is unaffected.

patches.name: Spoof Play Store signature
patches.description: Forces the Google license (Pairip) verdict branch to LICENSED and neutralizes the license payload's signature verification, so the patched/re-signed Everything Widgets build always passes store validation.

patches.name: Spoof Widevine / DRM level
patches.description:
Reports Widevine L1 (hardware DRM) to apps that check DRM level locally.

Useful for apps that refuse to play HD/4K content on L3 devices or after re-signing.

Does not bypass server-side DRM - Netflix, Disney+ and similar are not affected.
Applies to any app; no effect if the app does not query Widevine.

options.title: Widevine security level to report
options.description: L1 = hardware DRM (highest quality). L3 = software only. Default L1.

options.title: HDCP level to report
options.description: HDCP_V2_2 is required for 4K content on most streaming apps.

patches.name: Spoof Widevine level for MUBI
patches.description: Reports L1 / HDCP 2.2 to MUBI's local DRM checks. Server-side licensing still decides the resolution, so HD may remain unavailable.

patches.name: Spoof app signature
patches.description:
Makes the app think its signing certificate is unchanged after Morphe re-signs it.

Useful when an app crashes or shows a tamper warning because it checks its own certificate.

Does not bypass Play Integrity / SafetyNet hardware attestation.

Apply with Original app certificate patch.

options.title: Package name override (optional)
options.description: Leave blank — read automatically from the app. Only set this if you changed the app's package name and the patch is using the wrong one.

options.title: Certificate Base64 override (optional)
options.description: Leave blank to read the original certificate from the APK automatically. Only paste a Base64-encoded DER certificate here if auto-detection fails (for example because the APK was already re-signed).

patches.name: Spoof features
patches.description: Spoofs selectable Pixel Photos build and feature flags.

options.title: Pixel profile
options.description: Device profile used for Build fields and Pixel feature levels.

options.title: Android version
options.description: Optionally spoof Build.VERSION fields. Follow profile uses the selected Pixel's matching Android version.

options.title: Override ROM feature levels
options.description: Force newer Pixel feature flags off when the selected profile should not have them.

patches.name: Spoof install source
patches.description:
Makes the app think it was installed from a specific store (default: Google Play).

Useful when an app blocks features or shows errors because it detects it was not installed from the Play Store.

Only affects what the app itself sees - does not change the real system install record.

options.title: Store to impersonate
options.description: Most apps only check for the Google Play Store, so the default is usually correct. Pick from the list, or type any package name directly if your app checks for a different store.

patches.name: Stop Background Wakeups
patches.description: Disables the identified Chromium background-sync scheduler gate; other wakeups remain and site background sync can break.

patches.name: Stop Promo Notifications
patches.description: Disables identified Chromium tips and retention notification entry points; other notifications may remain.

patches.name: Stop Text Sharing with System
patches.description: Disables Chromium's OnscreenContentProvider content-capture gate, not every possible text-sharing mechanism.

patches.name: Strip logging (android.util.Log)
patches.description:
Removes all android.util.Log calls from the app, so logcat cannot leak
URLs, tokens, PII or debug output produced by the app.

Applies to any app. Safe.

patches.name: Suppress subscription paywall
patches.description: Closes MUBI's upgrade screen immediately instead of showing it. Does not unlock playback or grant a subscription; only hides the upsell screen.

patches.name: Unlock Account Entitlements
patches.description: Locally flips account-gating flags at the Account JSON adapter: can_create_subreddit, can_edit_name, password_set (kills the SSO 'set password' nag) and has_verified_email. Off by default; server entitlements still rule API actions.

patches.name: Unlock Excel
patches.description: Removes login requirement, unlocks premium, blocks ads, bypasses signature and code transparency checks.

patches.name: Unlock Full Version
patches.description: Bypasses the 15-day trial gate and unlocks all premium features in Inure App Manager.

patches.name: Unlock Lifetime
patches.description: Unlocks all Lifetime features in Proxyman.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Bypasses the Google license (Pairip) purchase check of the paid Everything Widgets app: the app runs fully without a Play purchase. Donation SKUs are cosmetic and untouched.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Flips the local isGold/has_gold_subscription account flags at the JSON adapter to enable Reddit Premium UI (custom icons, premium screens). Server-side perks cannot be unlocked.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Strava Premium features.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Telegram Premium features for the current account.

patches.name: Unlock Pro features
patches.description: Includes every registered feature in the resolved feature set by dropping the ownership check at the entitlement resolver (nv.e). LOCAL client-side effect only. WARNING (kept off by default): on at least one device (realme/Android 16) enabling the single registered Pro feature crashes capture - the Pro pipeline path is gated by this flag and we cannot verify its safety side. Enable only if you specifically want the Pro toolset; the app works fully (RAW capture incl.) with just 'Allow re-signed installs'.

patches.name: Unlock Ultimate
patches.description: Unlocks all Malwarebytes Ultimate features via enum singleton and feature gate patches.

patches.name: Unlock Unlimited Plan
patches.description: Forces Proton Pass Plus plan with all limits removed and paid features unlocked.

patches.name: Unlock VIP
patches.description: Unlocks VIP in trakt.TV Shows & Movies by forcing the parsed User.isVip flag to true (covers no-ads, advanced/saved filters, year-in-review and other local VIP gates). Methods delegating to the primary User constructor are covered automatically.

patches.name: Unlock VIP
patches.description: Unlocks Yatri VIP by forcing active plan status and spoofing active plan DB query.

patches.name: Unlock VPN Plus
patches.description: Injects max tier (3=PMTeam) into VpnUser at construction for all UI unlocks, while routing connections through free servers for server-side compatibility. Phone and TV

patches.name: Unlock Word
patches.description: Removes login requirement, unlocks premium, blocks ads, bypasses signature and code transparency checks.

patches.name: Use normal paste
patches.description: Skips Telegram's Rich HTML paste handler and falls back to the normal paste path.

patches.name: Voice to music
patches.description: Plays voice notes in the full music player with seek bar and background playback.

patches.name: WebView: block mixed content (HTTPS pages load HTTP subresources)
patches.description:
Forces WebSettings.setMixedContentMode to NEVER_ALLOW, so HTTPS pages in the
app's WebViews cannot load plaintext HTTP subresources.

Applies to any app. May break legacy web content inside the app.

patches.name: WebView: disable local file access
patches.description:
Disables WebView local file access (file://, content://, universal/file-URL
access) in every app, so web content cannot read the app's private files.

Applies to any app. Safe.

patches.name: WebView: remove JavaScript interface objects
patches.description:
Removes addJavascriptInterface bridges from the app's WebViews so loaded web
content cannot invoke injected Java objects.

Applies to any app. Web flows that depend on the bridge (some logins) may break.

patches.name: Mint: Block analytics & tracking SDKs
patches.description:
Blocks Mint's analytics & tracking SDKs (Firebase Analytics, AppsFlyer, Adjust,
WebEngage, CleverTap and similar) using the same universal heuristic as
'Block analytics & tracking SDKs'.

Applies to com.htmedia.mint only. Heuristic; obfuscated or reflection-based
reporting is not covered. Unverified on device.

patches.name: Hindustan Times: Block analytics & tracking SDKs
patches.description:
Blocks Hindustan Times' analytics & tracking SDKs (Firebase Analytics,
AppsFlyer, Adjust, WebEngage, CleverTap and similar) using the same universal
heuristic as 'Block analytics & tracking SDKs'.

Applies to com.ht.news only. Heuristic; obfuscated or reflection-based
reporting is not covered. Unverified on device.
